mapper.select:
/* master.mpst.selectReturnStatsList */
SELECT X.YYYYMM, X.WMRE_TYPE2, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'WM02' AND CODE = X.WMRE_TYPE2) AS WMRE_TYPE2_NAME, X.WMRE_TYPE3, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'WM04' AND CODE = X.WMRE_TYPE3) AS WMRE_TYPE3_NAME, X.WMRE_CNT, X.WMRE_AMT, X.TOT_WMRE_CNT, DECODE(X.TOT_WMRE_CNT, 0, 0, ROUND((X.WMRE_CNT / X.TOT_WMRE_CNT * 100), 1)) AS RATE, X.WMRE_TYPE4 FROM ( SELECT C.YYYYMM, C.WMRE_TYPE2, C.WMRE_TYPE3, SUM(C.WMRE_CNT) AS WMRE_CNT, SUM(C.WMRE_AMT) AS WMRE_AMT, SUM(C.TOT_WMRE_CNT) AS TOT_WMRE_CNT, MAX(C.WMRE_TYPE4) AS WMRE_TYPE4 FROM ( SELECT A.YYYYMM, A.WMRE_TYPE2, A.WMRE_TYPE3, A.WMRE_CNT, A.WMRE_AMT, ( SELECT SUM(WMRE_CNT) FROM KEPWMRE_MNG WHERE 1=1 AND ST_TYPE = 'A' AND YYYYMM = A.YYYYMM AND WMRE_TYPE2 = A.WMRE_TYPE2 GROUP BY YYYYMM, WMRE_TYPE2 ) AS TOT_WMRE_CNT, A.WMRE_TYPE4 FROM KEPWMRE_MNG A WHERE 1=1 AND A.YYYYMM = #{st_yyyymm} AND A.ST_TYPE = 'A' AND A.WMRE_TYPE4 = #{st_dept_code}
UNION ALL
SELECT #{st_yyyymm} AS YYYYMM, A.CODE AS WMRE_TYPE2, B.CODE AS WMRE_TYPE3, 0 AS WMRE_CNT, 0 AS WMRE_AMT, 0 AS TOT_WMRE_CNT, '' AS WMRE_TYPE4 FROM ICOMCOD1 A, ICOMCOD1 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.TYPE = 'WM02' AND B.TYPE = 'WM04' AND A.CODE = B.TEXT2 ) C GROUP BY C.YYYYMM, C.WMRE_TYPE2, C.WMRE_TYPE3 ) X WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY X.WMRE_TYPE2, RATE DESC, X.WMRE_TYPE3
SELECT X.YYYYMM, X.WMRE_TYPE2, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'WM02' AND CODE = X.WMRE_TYPE2) AS WMRE_TYPE2_NAME, X.WMRE_TYPE3, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'WM04' AND CODE = X.WMRE_TYPE3) AS WMRE_TYPE3_NAME, X.WMRE_CNT, X.WMRE_AMT, X.TOT_WMRE_CNT, DECODE(X.TOT_WMRE_CNT, 0, 0, ROUND((X.WMRE_CNT / X.TOT_WMRE_CNT * 100), 1)) AS RATE FROM ( SELECT C.YYYYMM, C.WMRE_TYPE2, C.WMRE_TYPE3, SUM(C.WMRE_CNT) AS WMRE_CNT, SUM(C.WMRE_AMT) AS WMRE_AMT, MAX(C.TOT_WMRE_CNT) AS TOT_WMRE_CNT FROM ( SELECT A.YYYYMM, A.WMRE_TYPE2, A.WMRE_TYPE3, A.WMRE_CNT, A.WMRE_AMT, ( SELECT SUM(WMRE_CNT) FROM KEPWMRE_MNG WHERE 1=1 AND ST_TYPE = 'A' AND YYYYMM = A.YYYYMM AND WMRE_TYPE2 = A.WMRE_TYPE2 GROUP BY YYYYMM, WMRE_TYPE2 ) AS TOT_WMRE_CNT FROM KEPWMRE_MNG A WHERE 1=1 AND A.YYYYMM = #{st_yyyymm} AND A.ST_TYPE = 'A'
UNION ALL
SELECT #{st_yyyymm} AS YYYYMM, A.CODE AS WMRE_TYPE2, B.CODE AS WMRE_TYPE3, 0 AS WMRE_CNT, 0 AS WMRE_AMT, 0 AS TOT_WMRE_CNT FROM ICOMCOD1 A, ICOMCOD1 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.TYPE = 'WM02' AND B.TYPE = 'WM04' AND A.CODE = B.TEXT2 ) C GROUP BY C.YYYYMM, C.WMRE_TYPE2, C.WMRE_TYPE3 ) X ORDER BY X.WMRE_TYPE2, RATE DESC
